summary: OpenGL/EGL and GL context code was improved to better coordinate with Metal ANGLE and the platform compositor: webrender and WebGL now synchronize using MTLSharedEvent/eglWaitUntilWorkScheduled so GPU work and Core Animation transactions don't race. Other changes avoid unnecessary combined depth-stencil buffers, ensure accelerated canvas uses fast GL paths, and refine context creation flags, leading to more reliable GPU rendering and correct readback behavior.
